title: centaurium × aschersonianum
intro: Centaurium × aschersonianum, commonly known as Ascherson's centaury or Mountain bluet, is a hybrid plant species within the Gentianaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Centaurium × aschersonianum involve its antispasmodic and expectorant properties, which aid in relaxing muscles and relieving coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
